entities.name: Cometia
entities.description: Lush crater oasis on the island of Shiv, formed by a comet.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: Island of Dominaria where Cometia lies.

entities.name: Adamkin
entities.description: Elf King during the Battle of the Breach.

entities.name: Strother
entities.description: One of the trio who attacked Cometia with a Serpent Generator.

entities.name: Borg
entities.description: One of the trio who attacked Cometia.

entities.name: Elam
entities.description: One of the trio who attacked Cometia.

entities.name: Snap
entities.description: Tiny twig dragon who plugged the serpent generator.

entities.name: Serpent Generator
entities.description: Machine used to ceaselessly attack Cometia's defenders.

entities.name: Battle of the Breach
entities.description: Battle at Cometia after an earthquake cracked the crater wall.

events.summary: A comet impacts Shiv, creating the crater of Cometia.
events.quote: Cometia was created long ago from the fall of a comet that impacted Shiv

events.summary: An earthquake cracks the crater wall; Strother, Borg and Elam attack with a Serpent Generator in the Battle of the Breach.
events.quote: This allowed the trio Strother , Borg , and Elam to use a Serpent Generator

events.summary: Snap plugs the generator, which explodes and fills the crack; Snap is rewarded.
events.quote: Snap, who had been flung clear from the generator in the explosion, was rewarded for his bravery.

events.summary: Cometia's caves become the staging grounds of the Second Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: The cave complex inside the crater served as the staging grounds of the Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria

relations.quote: Cometia is a lush crater oasis located on the island of Shiv .
